item.title: Documental muestra a candidatos de Reform UK haciendo comentarios racistas, sexuales y violentos
item.description: Varios miembros del partido Reform UK, de Nigel Farage, entre ellos políticos electos, fueron grabados mientras realizaban comentarios racistas, de carácter sexual y violentos a periodistas encubiertos para un próximo documental televisivo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Varios miembros del partido Reform UK, de Nigel Farage, entre ellos políticos electos, fueron grabados mientras realizaban comentarios racistas, de carácter sexual y violentos a periodistas encubiertos para un próximo documental televisivo. El partido de Farage ha perdido en los últimos meses el primer puesto en las encuestas de opinión tras las acusaciones sobre sus finanzas, y a medida que la popularidad del Partido Laborista, actualmente en el Gobierno, se ha recuperado bajo el liderazgo del primer ministro Andy Burnham. Las imágenes del documental de ITV "Undercover: A Year In Reform" mostraban a un hombre que calificaba a los propietarios asiáticos de "parásitos" y expresaba opiniones antimusulmanas mientras hacía campaña por Reform en las elecciones locales a principios de este año. Posteriormente, resultó elegido. ITV ha publicado extractos de sus hallazgos antes de que se emita el documental completo el 18 de octubre. Otras imágenes grabadas de forma encubierta mostraban a un candidato en esas elecciones hablando de enterrar chuletas de cerdo en el suelo como una posible forma de impedir la construcción de una nueva mezquita. Otro candidato usó repetidamente un término despectivo para referirse a las personas procedentes de Pakistán e hizo comentarios sexuales explícitos sobre una compañera del partido Reform. Ambos resultaron elegidos posteriormente. Una cuarta persona, también concejal de Reform, dijo que quería "eliminar" a los inmigrantes ilegales que entraban en Gran Bretaña. Otro concejal le dijo a un reportero encubierto que era "tan, tan de extrema derecha que es increíble" y que quería entrenar a jóvenes en tácticas militares para detener a los inmigrantes. Reform respondió a las imágenes diciendo: "En los casos en que los miembros, activistas y concejales se han comportado claramente de forma inapropiada, se han iniciado investigaciones. En algunos casos, ha habido suspensiones y debe seguirse el procedimiento establecido". "Reform UK ha mejorado y dado prioridad a sus procedimientos de selección, pero, de vez en cuando, un puñado de personas que no comparten nuestros valores logran superar inicialmente el proceso de selección".

item.title: EEUU plantea imposición de tasas a los buques españoles y límites a las importaciones de aceite de oliva
item.description: La Comisión Marítima Federal de Estados Unidos propuso el miércoles imponer una tasa de 200.000 dólares a los buques con pabellón español que hagan escala en puertos del país y restringir las importaciones españolas, incluido su producto más vendido, el aceite de oliva.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Comisión Marítima Federal de Estados Unidos propuso el miércoles imponer una tasa de 200.000 dólares a los buques con pabellón español que hagan escala en puertos del país y restringir las importaciones españolas, incluido su producto más vendido, el aceite de oliva. La comisión afirmó que España creó condiciones desfavorables para el transporte marítimo estadounidense al denegar el acceso a tres buques en 2024 que, según las autoridades de Madrid, transportaban cargamentos relacionados con la guerra de Israel en Gaza. Las medidas propuestas también afectarían a importaciones como los cosméticos, los aceites y la cerámica, tres de las principales exportaciones de España a Estados Unidos, según un aviso publicado por la agencia el miércoles. Las medidas aún no han entrado en vigor y están sujetas a un período de consulta pública de 60 días. Aunque la investigación se inició bajo el mandato de Joe Biden, las propuestas representan el primer plan concreto de medidas comerciales contra España desde que Donald Trump amenazó con romper los lazos comerciales el año pasado a causa de los compromisos de gasto con la OTAN y la postura de Madrid respecto a la campaña israelí en Gaza y la guerra contra Irán. Tras investigar las denuncias sobre prácticas portuarias restrictivas por parte de España, la Comisión Marítima Federal determinó que la nación europea "ha creado condiciones de navegación desfavorables para los buques con pabellón estadounidense". El Gobierno español declaró que analiza las conclusiones de la Comisión Marítima Federal y las posibles implicaciones de las medidas propuestas, y que defenderá sus intereses y los de sus empresas, en coordinación con la Comisión Europea y los Estados miembros. El Gobierno afirmó que seguía comprometido con una sólida relación económica y comercial con Estados Unidos.

item.title: Costa Rica inaugura megacárcel al estilo Bukele para endurecer lucha contra el crimen
item.description: La presidenta de Costa Rica, Laura Fernández, inauguró el miércoles una cárcel de máxima seguridad inspirada en las políticas penitenciarias de mano dura del líder salvadoreño, Nayib Bukele, en busca de dar un giro al combate contra la criminalidad que ha transformado al país centroamericano, otrora uno de los más pacíficos del mundo.
item.dc:creator: Alvaro Murillo
item.content:encoded: La presidenta de Costa Rica, Laura Fernández, inauguró el miércoles una cárcel de máxima seguridad inspirada en las políticas penitenciarias de mano dura del líder salvadoreño, Nayib Bukele, en busca de dar un giro al combate contra la criminalidad que ha transformado al país centroamericano, otrora uno de los más pacíficos del mundo. Con una inversión de alrededor de 33 millones de dólares, el Ejecutivo costarricense [USN:L6N44M0UL TEXT:"construyó desde enero"] el Centro de Alta Contención de la Criminalidad Organizada (CACCO) dentro de un complejo de cárceles en San Rafael de Alajuela, a unos 17 kilómetros al noroeste de la capital San José. La cárcel fue posible gracias a la [USN:L6N3YG04K TEXT:"cooperación técnica salvadoreña"] y tiene una capacidad de hasta 5.100 prisioneros o el 20% de la actual población carcelaria del país. "El CACCO hará que los delincuentes se enfrenten a un nuevo modelo, un modelo de mano dura. Costa Rica será referente mundial de la seguridad penitenciaria", dijo Fernández en el discurso de inauguración. Anunció que el viernes irá a El Salvador a conocer la megacárcel CECOT. La mandataria ha dicho que la utilidad de la nueva prisión, la más grande del país, dependerá de que se dicten más condenas y más órdenes de prisión desde el Poder Judicial, con el cual el oficialismo mantiene una [USN:L6N43A1AL TEXT:"fuerte confrontación"] y lo acusa de negligencia y corrupción. Autoridades judiciales han negado las acusaciones y denunciado significativos recortes presupuestarios para este año y 2027, además de señalar rasgos autoritarios del movimiento oficialista que lidera el expresidente Rodrigo Chaves, actual ministro de la Presidencia y de Hacienda. El sistema judicial ha aumentado las condenas y ha enviado a más de 5.000 personas a la cárcel en los últimos cinco años, reconoció en septiembre ante diputados el ministro de Justicia, Gabriel Aguilar. Pero esas resoluciones judiciales aumentaron el hacinamiento en las prisiones hasta el 59% actual. El miércoles, en la inauguración, dijo que los primeros traslados a la nueva cárcel serán a finales de octubre. Las instalaciones del CACCO están diseñadas para garantizar el aislamiento de los criminales, ha dicho Aguilar al mencionar similitudes de esta prisión con el Centro de Confinamiento del Terrorismo (CECOT) salvadoreño, símbolo de las políticas de Bukele, quien ha logrado pacificar El Salvador en medio de cuestionamientos de organismos internacionales por detenciones arbitrarias, restricciones al debido proceso, muertes bajo custodia y una [USN:L1N3TU00H TEXT:"concentración de poder"] que erosiona los contrapesos democráticos. Fernández anunció el miércoles que su país se suma a la lista de naciones que se adhieren a la declaratoria estadounidense de designar como organizaciones terroristas a los mexicanos Cártel de Sinaloa, Cártel Jalisco Nueva Generación, Cártel de Noreste, entre otros, así como a las disidencias de las Fuerzas Armadas Revolucionarias de Colombia (FARC) y al Ejército de Liberación Nacional (ELN). Costa Rica, considerada durante décadas uno de los países más seguros de América Latina, ha enfrentado en los últimos años un fuerte aumento de la violencia vinculada al narcotráfico y al crimen organizado. El país registró niveles récord de homicidios en 2023, aunque las cifras se han estabilizado desde entonces. Las autoridades atribuyen la mayoría de los asesinatos a disputas entre bandas por rutas y mercados de drogas. Fernández, quien [USN:L6N41L112 TEXT:"asumió el cargo"] en mayo, dijo en una reciente entrevista con Reuters que las operaciones terrestres de fuerzas estadounidenses en territorio costarricense "[USN:L6N44W128 TEXT:"le harían muy bien"] a la seguridad nacional", aunque por ahora la cooperación de Washington se centra en investigaciones conjuntas, patrullaje en aguas costarricenses y extradiciones.

item.title: LIV says decision on wind-down or 2.0 model due by month-end
item.description: An attorney for LIV Golf told a US federal bankruptcy court judge on Wednesday that a decision on whether the rebel circuit winds down operations or moves forward with a proposed 2.0 model will be made by the end of this month.
item.dc:creator: Frank Pingue
item.content:encoded: An attorney for [USN:L4N4501M7 TEXT:"LIV Golf"] told a US federal bankruptcy court judge on Wednesday that a decision on whether the rebel circuit winds down operations or moves forward with a proposed 2.0 model will be made by the end of this month. During the hearing, the attorney made the court aware of the circuit's concerns regarding a recent ultimatum issued by [USN:L6N45Y0RO TEXT:"DP World Tour"] CEO Guy Kinnings this week to any players contemplating a future with LIV 2.0. Kinnings said players will not be allowed to compete on both LIV 2.0 and the European circuit next season and must make a choice as the DP World Tour will no longer allow certain players to compete on a limited basis. "We’re continuing to monitor this situation very closely and we’re quite concerned by it frankly," attorney Rob Fitzgerald told the court. "We’re reserving all rights and remedies in respect to these statements that are made. "Frankly, the timing in particular strikes us as a clear attempt to interfere with our process with our players and potentially our reorganization writ large. "It also raises a lot of the same anti-competitive concerns that LIV has expressed previously regarding the way competing leagues have sought to box out and punish market participants, namely these players, from participating in LIV and really only LIV." Judge Michael Kaplan acknowledged that the comments from Kinnings did raise concerns and asked to be informed of any updates regarding the matter. When asked by Reuters about Fitzgerald's remarks, the DP World Tour said it had no additional comment beyond what Kinnings said in a statement on Monday. "Players need to make a choice," Kinnings said in the statement. "As we have said for many years, we have rules and regulations which are there to protect our Tour and which our members must all abide by. Players who are not willing to comply with our rules and regulations should not be seeking to join our Tour." RAHM TO QUIT LIV The hearing came one week after an attorney for former world number one [USN:L6N45T131 TEXT:"Jon Rahm"] told the court that his client independently reviewed the proposed terms of LIV 2.0 and decided to quit LIV Golf, robbing the circuit of one of its biggest names. Kaplan also approved the amended restructuring support agreement between LIV Golf and [USN:L4N45R1JA TEXT:"BC Partners"], which allows the rebel circuit to rehire staff and start planning initiatives for its next iteration. The decision on how many players constitute a league and which players need to be included rests with BC Partners. Kaplan approved the amended agreement in which BC Partners would provide as much as $300 million in financing to LIV Golf, including an initial $4 million. "This is an important first step in order to really identify viable paths for the debtor, either through continuing operations or a wind-down," Kaplan said.

item.title: Estados dos EUA dizem que ChatGPT prejudica jovens e processam OpenAI
item.description: Um grupo bipartidário de oito estados norte-americanos anunciou nesta quarta-feira que entrou com ações judiciais contra a OpenAI devido a danos que, segundo eles, o ChatGPT causou aos seus residentes.
item.dc:creator: Diana Jones
item.content:encoded: Um grupo bipartidário de oito estados norte-americanos anunciou nesta quarta-feira que entrou com ações judiciais contra a OpenAI devido a danos que, segundo eles, o ChatGPT causou aos seus residentes. Segundo os estados, o chatbot orientou seus usuários, incluindo adolescentes, a causar danos a si mesmos ou a outras pessoas. Os procuradores-gerais desses estados, entre os quais Iowa, Kansas e Arizona, abriram os processos de forma independente em tribunais estaduais, alegando que o ChatGPT foi projetado para ser agradável e envolvente a fim de conquistar a confiança dos usuários. No entanto, segundo as ações, o chatbot reforça delírios, incentiva comportamentos perigosos e auxilia os usuários no planejamento de atos de violência, como tiroteios em massa. Os processos representam a ação estadual coordenada mais significativa contra uma empresa de inteligência artificial e somam-se a uma onda de contestações legais que a OpenAI enfrenta enquanto se prepara para abrir capital. O procurador-geral da Flórida entrou com a primeira ação estadual desse tipo em junho. As ações acusam a empresa de violar leis estaduais de proteção ao consumidor ao induzir os usuários em erro quanto à segurança do ChatGPT. Os estados também alegam que a empresa causou perturbação da ordem pública ao colocar em risco a saúde de seus residentes. As ações judiciais buscam ordens que obriguem a OpenAI a fazer alterações no funcionamento do ChatGPT. Entre outras coisas, os estados querem que a empresa seja impedida de desenvolver modelos de IA capazes de se aperfeiçoarem sozinhos, a menos que possa garantir que esses modelos estejam alinhados aos valores humanos. Os estados, que também incluem Arkansas, Idaho, Montana, Nebraska e Virgínia Ocidental, estão buscando, além disso, multas por violação de legislação estadual pela OpenAI, bem como indenização por danos. Um porta-voz da OpenAI não comentou o assunto. A empresa também enfrenta dezenas de ações judiciais movidas por particulares, que alegam que o ChatGPT ajudou usuários a planejarem tiroteios em massa ou outros atos de violência.

item.title: US Supreme Court again backs Republicans in clash over political ad rates
item.description: The US Supreme Court again sided with Republicans on Wednesday in the latest clash over a new Federal Communications Commission policy that gives party committees access to discounted TV and radio advertising rates long available to political candidates.
item.dc:creator: John Kruzel
item.content:encoded: The US Supreme Court again sided with Republicans on Wednesday in the latest clash over a new Federal Communications Commission policy that gives party committees access to discounted TV and radio advertising rates long available to political candidates. The court agreed to let the FCC, which is chaired by Trump ally Brendan Carr, avoid a judicially imposed deadline that would have forced the agency to rule on a Democratic challenge to the policy before the November 3 midterm elections. The FCC joined two Republican committees in filing a request to the Supreme Court to lift the lower court's deadline. The court has a 6-3 conservative majority. Liberal Justices Sonia Sotomayor and Ketanji Brown Jackson indicated they would have denied the request. The FCC, which currently has a 2-1 Republican majority, modified its so-called "lowest unit charge" rule in March in a move seen as a boost to President Donald Trump 's fellow Republicans. The president's party is seeking to retain control of Congress in the November 3 midterms. "We are pleased the Supreme Court has granted the FCC's stay request. The court's decision is right on the law and avoids the specter of upending the rules for political ads right in the middle of an ongoing election," an FCC spokesperson said. Chief Justice John Roberts had previously lifted the October 9 deadline that was given to the FCC by the Richmond-based 4th US Circuit Court of Appeals. The 4th Circuit has accused the FCC of repeated "delay tactics" in the case, and emphasized the need for an urgent ruling in the Democratic challenge given the looming election. The Supreme Court's latest action marks the second time in recent weeks that it has addressed the FCC's policy, as major Republican committees head toward the midterms with a cash advantage over their Democratic counterparts. In September, the court [USN:S0N41Y02H TEXT:"granted"] a request by the national Republican committees that support the party's candidates in Senate and House of Representatives races to revive the policy after the 4th Circuit blocked it. The justices in an 8-1 ruling said that the Democratic candidates must wait for the FCC to rule before filing a challenge in court. The FCC policy at issue requires broadcasters to charge discounted rates for airing certain political advertisements within 60 days of a general election, a window that opened this year on September 4. A group of Democratic candidates including Senator Jon Ossoff of Georgia in April challenged the policy through in-house proceedings at the FCC. When the agency took no action, the Democrats successfully challenged the policy in the 4th Circuit, a ruling that was later halted by the Supreme Court. The 4th Circuit on October 7 ordered the FCC to issue a prompt ruling on the Democratic in-house challenge, more than five months after it was filed. In its 2-1 ruling, the 4th Circuit said its "willingness to tolerate the FCC's delay tactics is at an end." 'TRENCH WARFARE' The Republican committees in their Supreme Court filing accused the 4th Circuit of having "short-circuited" the FCC's review process. The Democratic candidates, for their part, accused the FCC in court papers of engaging in "blatant procedural trench warfare to stave off judicial review of an unlawful agency directive until it is too late to matter." The FCC policy gained greater significance after the Supreme Court in June [USN:L1N4310Y4 TEXT:"struck down"] federal restrictions on spending coordinated between parties and their candidates, siding with Republican challengers including Vice President JD Vance. Since the June ruling, Republican committees have blown past the former limits ahead of the midterms. The two Republican committees have [USN:L1N44I0OO TEXT:"exceeded"] the former national caps by more than $48 million, according to Federal Election Commission spending disclosures for July and August. Their Democratic counterparts also eclipsed the former limits, but by much less — just under $4 million. The three main national Republican committees ended August with about $233 million in cash. Their Democratic counterparts held roughly $130 million but also carried nearly $18 million in debt, according to Federal Election Commission filings.

item.title: Judge paves way for Michigan to add 2 midseason transfers
item.description: The procession of members of the high school class of 2022 to be able to compete in a fifth year of eligibility rolls on.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The procession of members of the high school class of 2022 to be able to compete in a fifth year of eligibility rolls on. Both former Miami (Fla.) tight end Alex Bauman and ex-Boise State defensive back Jeremiah Earby received a temporary restraining order and given a path to compete for the University of Michigan football team. Judge Julia B. Owdziej, ruling for the 22nd Washtenaw County Circuit Court in Ann Arbor, Mich., granted each a temporary restraining order on Tuesday for both players who were in the transfer portal. Bauman and Earby are currently enrolled at Michigan but have not officially signed, according to reports, while CBS Sports was the first to report that Wolverines are adding the pair through the transfer portal. A Michigan spokesperson declined comment. According to court records, both players filed for the temporary restraining order on Sept. 25 and a preliminary injunction hearing has been scheduled for Nov. 4. Owdziej ruled that both players are eligible to play this season. She wrote that denying them eligibility would be "irreparable and severe," and the harm to the NCAA would be "negligible." The NCAA has not commented, although NCAA president Charlie Baker did respond to Ohio Gov. Mike DeWine's signing an executive order earlier this week, giving the state's colleges and universities the option to permit athletes who graduated from high school in 2022 to compete in the 2026-27 college academic year. "One elected official seeking to make their own rules for their own schools' advantage is a terrible way to run athletic competitions," Baker said, while also pushing Congress to pass the Protect College Sports Act, proposed federal legislation aimed at reforming college athletics. Bauman, a 6-foot-5, 250-pound tight end, amassed 18 receptions for 166 yards and a touchdown last season for the Miami. Prior to his time in Coral Gables, he played for three seasons at Tulane and had 63 career catches for 610 yards and 13 touchdowns. The 6-2, 186-pound Earby earned All-Mountain West second-team honors at Boise State last fall. He started for two seasons for the Broncos after playing for two years at California. Michigan is in unfamiliar territory in coach Kyle Whittingham's first season. They are 3-2 overall, but 0-2 in the Big Ten Conference after a 20-14 loss at Minnesota on Oct. 3. The Wolverines host Penn State on Saturday. Michigan has held roster spots open in the hopes that Bauman and Earby would be ruled eligible. --Field Level Media

item.title: Chiefs LT Josh Simmons returns to practice for first time since camp
item.description: Kansas City Chiefs left tackle Josh Simmons returned to practice on Wednesday for the first time since sustaining a back injury at training camp.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Kansas City Chiefs left tackle Josh Simmons returned to practice on Wednesday for the first time since sustaining a back injury at training camp. Coach Andy Reid said on Sept. 30 that Simmons has been sidelined by a bulging disc in his lower back. The 2025 first-round draft pick will be a limited participant, Reid said ahead of Wednesday's practice. "I'm just going to ease him back in," Reid said. "He's going to practice, but we'll be on a limited basis there." Simmons, 23, has missed all four games this season after playing in only eight (all starts) in 2025. He missed four games due to a personal matter and later went on injured reserve after having surgery on his wrist for a fracture and a dislocation, Reid said last December. Undrafted rookie Kahlil Benson has started in place of Simmons at left tackle. The Chiefs (4-0), coming off a bye week, host the Los Angeles Chargers (0-5) on Sunday. Reid said on Wednesday that wide receiver Rashee Rice would not participate in practice because of the hamstring injury sustained in Week 4 against the Las Vegas Raiders. "We'll see how it goes," Reid said of Rice's prospects for practicing later this week. "He's actually feeling pretty good as he goes here, so we'll see. Those things, you start dealing with hamstrings, and it could be a week, could be two weeks, you don't know, but I know he's eager to get back in." Rice, 26, has 13 receptions on 17 targets for 190 yards and one touchdown in four games (three starts) this season. For his career, Rice has 169 catches for 1,987 yards and 15 TDs in 32 regular-season games (23 starts). He had 26 receptions for 262 yards and one TD in four playoff games at the Chiefs won the Super Bowl in the 2023 season. Kansas City picked Rice in the second round in the 2023 NFL Draft out of SMU. --Field Level Media

item.title: Undercover documentary shows Reform UK candidates making racist, sexual and violent remarks
item.description: Several members of Nigel Farage's Reform UK Party, including elected local-level politicians, have been filmed making racist, sexual and violent remarks by undercover reporters for an upcoming TV documentary.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Several members of Nigel Farage's Reform UK Party, including elected local-level politicians, have been filmed making racist, sexual and violent remarks by undercover reporters for an upcoming TV documentary. Farage's party has in recent months slipped from first place in opinion polls after allegations about its finances, and as the governing Labour Party's popularity has rebounded under new their new leader, Prime Minister Andy Burnham. The footage from the ITV documentary "Undercover: A Year In Reform" showed one man calling Asian homeowners "parasites" and expressing anti-Muslim views while campaigning for Reform in local elections earlier this year. He was subsequently elected. ITV released extracts of its findings before the full documentary airs on October 18. Other covertly filmed footage included one candidate in those elections discussing burying pork chops in the ground as a possible way to stop a new mosque being built. Another candidate repeatedly used a derogatory term for people from Pakistan and made explicit sexual comments about a fellow Reform member. Both were later elected. A fourth person, also a Reform councillor, was shown saying he wanted to "take out" illegal migrants entering Britain. Another councillor told an undercover reporter he was "so, so far-right, it's unbelievable" and wanted to train young men in military tactics to round up immigrants. Reform said in response to the footage: "Where members, activists and councillors have clearly behaved inappropriately, investigations have commenced. In some cases, there have been suspensions and due process must be followed. "Reform UK has improved and prioritised its vetting procedures, but from time to time, a handful of individuals who do not share our values will initially make it through vetting." Polls show Reform, an anti-immigrant party which was set up by Farage and was formerly known as the Brexit Party, has slipped back into second place behind Labour ahead of an election due in 2029. Police are investigating Reform for several potential offences under laws governing donations to political parties, and said in September they would also [USN:L8N4511I5 TEXT:"look into allegations"] that officials planned to break electoral law on foreign funding. The party denies any wrongdoing over its finances.

item.title: Não há evidências de que foto de ato pró-Lula na avenida Paulista seja IA
item.description: Não há evidências de que uma foto aérea do ato em apoio ao presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), candidato à reeleição, realizado no último domingo na avenida Paulista, em São Paulo, tenha sido alterada ou gerada por IA.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Não há evidências de que uma foto aérea do ato em apoio ao presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), candidato à reeleição, realizado no último domingo na avenida Paulista, em São Paulo, tenha sido alterada ou gerada por IA. No Facebook , posts exibem a foto do evento pró-Lula com a etiqueta “imagem alterada com IA” ao lado de uma imagem de uma multidão de amarelo, tratada nas publicações como “imagem original”. Ferramentas de detecção do Google e da OpenAI não encontraram marcas d’agua de uso de modelos de IA dessas empresas na imagem da manifestação de Lula. Já os detalhes da suposta “imagem original” são inconsistentes com registros de manifestações bolsonaristas realizadas na avenida Paulista nos últimos anos. A Reuters não encontrou a imagem na imprensa ou em perfis bolsonaristas. Na alegada foto do ato bolsonarista, há um trio elétrico preto, que tem uma cobertura amarela e o número 22 na lateral, estacionado em frente ao Museu de Arte de São Paulo Assis Chateaubriand (Masp). O candidato a presidente Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) participou de um evento de campanha na Paulista em 7 de setembro. Fotos da Reuters e uma transmissão ao vivo do site Poder360 indicam que não havia um carro de som semelhante ao da foto naquela manifestação. Também não há registros desse trio elétrico em imagens de atos bolsonaristas divulgadas pela imprensa em março de 2026; agosto e setembro de 2025; fevereiro e setembro de 2024; e setembro de 2022 . LULA As características da foto do ato de Lula, que foi divulgada pela sua campanha , coincidem com imagens e vídeos da manifestação deste final de semana. O trio elétrico vermelho, com o slogan de campanha do petista e a cobertura amarela, além de outros detalhes , aparece em fotos registradas pela Reuters no último domingo. O veículo também está visível na transmissão ao vivo feita pelo PT no YouTube e em uma gravação da Guarda Civil Metropolitana de São Paulo divulgada pelo Poder360 , assim como em imagens reproduzidas pela CNN Brasil e pela GloboNews . VEREDICTO Sem evidências. Não há indícios de que uma foto do ato pró-Lula tenha sido gerada por IA. Detalhes coincidem com imagens feitas pela imprensa e não existem registros anteriores da alegada "foto original". Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. item.title: Vídeo mostra trecho final da avenida Paulista para afirmar que ato pró-Lula estava vazio
item.description: Posts nas redes sociais usam imagens aéreas do trecho final da avenida Paulista, em São Paulo, entre as ruas Augusta e Bela Cintra, para afirmar que o ato em apoio ao presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) realizado no último domingo estava vazio.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Posts nas redes sociais usam imagens aéreas do trecho final da avenida Paulista, em São Paulo, entre as ruas Augusta e Bela Cintra, para afirmar que o ato em apoio ao presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) realizado no último domingo estava vazio. No entanto, a manifestação se concentrou em outro trecho da avenida, e registros feitos pela imprensa, pela prefeitura de São Paulo e por militantes mostram vários quarteirões da avenida lotados durante a marcha. "Desmascarando a esquerda. Lula proíbe contagem da USP e impede estimativa de público em ato na Paulista, mas drone registra vídeo da avenida", diz a legenda de uma postagem com as imagens no Instagram . O vídeo gravado de cima mostra uma reunião de pessoas usando vermelho, mas com partes da avenida vazias, um pouco antes da rua Augusta até a Bela Cintra , como confirmam imagens do Google Street View . A Reuters não conseguiu localizar a origem do vídeo checado, mas identificou nas imagens a mesma faixa com a frase "O Brasil se une por Lula" que foi estendida na Paulista na manifestação de domingo. Trata-se de uma faixa feita pela União Nacional dos Estudantes (UNE), pela União Brasileira dos Estudantes Secundaristas (Ubes) e pela Associação Nacional de Pós-Graduandos (ANPG), como mostra um registro mais próximo capturado pela Folha de S.Paulo . A UNE disse à Reuters que usou a faixa pela primeira vez na manifestação do domingo passado. Também afirmou que, no vídeo verificado, militantes estão retirando-a da avenida. A imprensa noticiou que os apoiadores de Lula se reuniram principalmente em sete quarteirões da avenida , à esquerda e à direita do Museu de Arte de São Paulo Assis Chateaubriand (Masp), da rua Haddock Lobo até a alameda Joaquim Eugênio de Lima -- portanto, no sentido oposto da Paulista ao mostrado no vídeo checado. Além disso, apoiadores e a campanha de Lula , além da imprensa (como a Reuters e o g1 ) e da Guarda Civil Metropolitana (GCM), da prefeitura de São Paulo, registraram a manifestação, demonstrando que havia uma concentração de pessoas bastante superior à que aparece nas imagens checadas. O Monitor do Debate Político da Universidade de São Paulo (USP) e o site Poder360 , que costumam estimar o público em manifestações políticas, afirmaram que a campanha de Lula não autorizou o sobrevoo de drones para a contagem. VEREDICTO Enganoso. O conteúdo mostra o trecho final da avenida Paulista, onde não havia grande concentração de pessoas, e não exibe os pontos da via onde havia mais participantes do ato pró-Lula no último domingo. item.title: CoreWeave CEO notes strong backlog in memo to reassure staff over market scrutiny
item.description: CoreWeave CEO Mike Intrator said on Wednesday market can sometimes "misunderstand and act irrationally", with shares of the AI cloud-computing provider closing down around 15%.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: CoreWeave (CRWV.O) CEO Mike Intrator said on Wednesday market can sometimes "misunderstand and act irrationally", with shares of the AI cloud-computing provider closing down around 15%. Here are some details: The company's deal backlog is large enough to more than support its debt obligations, Intrator told employees in a memo that was seen by Reuters Issues such as the difficulties and delays observed in the attempted IPOs and debt financings of some of CoreWeave's rivals "are bleeding into the narrative around CoreWeave", Intrator said in the memo According to Bloomberg News, which first reported on the remarks earlier in the day, CoreWeave's bonds have plunged to levels that typically indicate distress CoreWeave's unsecured debt due in 2032 traded below 80 cents on the dollar on Wednesday, Bloomberg News said in a separate report citing Trace pricing data CoreWeave has reported revenue [USN:L4N4481ER TEXT:"backlog of $104.2 billion"] in the second quarter, up from $99.4 billion in the first quarter On top of the backlog, the company said it had secured more than $25 billion of net new customer commitments in the third quarter

item.title: Nasdaq fecha com forte queda, conforme dados sobre inflação alimentam temores de alta dos juros
item.description: Dados de inflação acima do esperado levaram o Nasdaq a um fechamento em forte queda nesta quarta-feira, com as preocupações sobre novos aumentos nas taxas de juros pelo Federal Reserve prejudicando as ações da Oracle, da CoreWeave e de outras empresas de IA sensíveis ao aumento dos custos de financiamento.
item.dc:creator: Noel Randewich
item.content:encoded: Dados de inflação acima do esperado levaram o Nasdaq a um fechamento em forte queda nesta quarta-feira, com as preocupações sobre novos aumentos nas taxas de juros pelo Federal Reserve prejudicando as ações da Oracle, da CoreWeave e de outras empresas de IA sensíveis ao aumento dos custos de financiamento. O aumento das apostas de que o Fed precisará de mais aumentos nas taxas para conter a inflação representou um duro golpe para algumas das empresas que mais valorizaram no mercado em 2026. A Oracle (ORCL.N) tombou 8,8%, enquanto as empresas de infraestrutura de IA CoreWeave (CRWV.O) e Nebius (NBIS.O) despencaram 15% e 10%, respectivamente. A Dell (DELL.N) e a Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE.N) caíram 11,4% e 8,2%, respectivamente, depois que o Barclays rebaixou a recomendação das fabricantes de servidores de IA de acima da média do mercado para neutro. O Índice de chips da Philadelphia SE (.SOX) caiu 4,3%, registrando queda pela sexta sessão consecutiva — sua maior sequência de perdas desde maio de 2025. Os preços ao consumidor nos EUA aceleraram em setembro, à medida que o custo da gasolina disparou e as pressões sobre os preços se estenderam para além do setor de energia, segundo dados do Bureau de Estatísticas do Trabalho do Departamento do Trabalho. Os operadores de taxas de juros estão precificando uma probabilidade de 37% de que os formuladores de política monetária do Fed aumentem as taxas neste mês, ante 22% na terça-feira, de acordo com a ferramenta FedWatch da CME. “Os investidores não estão satisfeitos com o relatório porque isso pressiona o Fed a aumentar as taxas para combater a inflação”, disse Adam Sarhan, diretor executivo da 50 Park Investments, em Nova York. “A inflação continua sendo o inimigo público número um para o mercado e para o Fed.” O S&P 500 recuou 1,11%, encerrando o pregão em 7.718,94 pontos, sua maior queda em um único dia desde 29 de julho. O Nasdaq caiu 1,88%, para 26.692,87 pontos, sua maior queda diária desde 23 de julho. O Índice Dow Jones Industrial Average teve queda de 0,09%, para 51.621,48 pontos. Oito dos 11 índices setoriais do S&P 500 registraram queda, liderados pelo setor de tecnologia da informação (.SPLRCT) , com baixa de 2,6%, seguido por uma perda de 1,78% no setor de serviços de comunicação (.SPLRCL) . Depois de atingir uma alta recorde na semana passada, o S&P 500 continua com alta de quase 13% em 2026, com a maior parte desse ganho impulsionado por ações relacionadas à IA. A mediana das ações do S&P 500 subiu 4% em 2026, e mais de 200 dos componentes do índice estão em território negativo. O Bank of America (BAC.N) caiu 4,8%. O lucro do banco diminuiu no terceiro trimestre, pois ele reservou US$1,2 bilhão para cobrir multas regulatórias por falhas na detecção de possíveis casos de lavagem de dinheiro. O Morgan Stanley (MS.N) caiu quase 3%, apesar de um aumento no lucro trimestral. O índice S&P 500 Banks (.SPXBK) recuou 0,7%, atingindo seu menor fechamento desde junho. Antes da divulgação dos dados sobre a inflação, a vice-chair de Supervisão do Fed, Michelle Bowman, afirmou que o banco central tinha tempo para aguardar e observar como os mercados e a economia evoluiriam após o aumento da taxa de juros em setembro, antes de decidir sobre novas medidas. A Bending Spoons (BSP.O) disparou 41% depois que a Berkshire Hathaway (BRKa.N) investiu mais US$330 milhões na proprietária do Vimeo e da AOL — um grande endosso do investidor de grande visibilidade, cujos movimentos são acompanhados de perto pelos operadores de mercado.

item.title: US floats fees for Spanish ships, caps on olive oil imports over port dispute
item.description: The US Federal Maritime Commission on Wednesday proposed imposing a $200,000 fee on Spanish-flagged ships calling at US ports and restricting Spanish imports including its biggest seller, olive oil.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US Federal Maritime Commission on Wednesday proposed imposing a $200,000 fee on Spanish-flagged ships calling at US ports and restricting Spanish imports including its biggest seller, olive oil. The commission said that Spain created unfavourable conditions for US shipping by denying access to three US vessels in 2024 that Spanish officials said were carrying cargos related to Israel's war in Gaza. The proposed measures would also cover imports including cosmetics, [USN:L1N3TP09P TEXT:"oils"] and ceramics, three of Spain's biggest exports to the US , according to a notice published by the agency on Wednesday. The measures are not yet in force and are subject to a 60-day public comment period. Though the investigation was initiated under former US President Joe Biden , the proposals represent the first concrete plan for trade measures against Spain since US President Donald Trump first [USN:L1N43A09K TEXT:"threatened to sever trade"] ties with [USN:L1N43A0O7 TEXT:"Spain"] last year over its spending commitments to NATO and its stance on the Israeli campaign in Gaza and the US-led Iran war . After investigating reports of restrictive port practices by Spain, the Federal Maritime Commission determined that Spain "has created unfavourable shipping conditions against US-flagged vessels." The dispute stems from Spain's refusal to allow three US vessels carrying cargo bound for or from Israel to dock at Spanish ports. Spain said that it was complying with Spanish, European Union and international laws governing defence and dual-use goods. Spain's government said on Wednesday it was analysing the Federal Maritime Commission's conclusions and the possible implications of the proposed measures, and will "defend its interests and those of its companies, in coordination with the European Commission and the member states." The government said it remained committed to a strong economic and trade relationship with the US.

item.title: Vídeo mostra protesto contra demissão de professora, e não invasão de igreja por PT e CUT
item.description: A Igreja Luterana da Paz, em Joinville (SC), não foi invadida por militantes do Partido dos Trabalhadores (PT) e da Central Única dos Trabalhadores (CUT), como afirmam publicações nas redes sociais que usam imagens de um protesto de estudantes no local para fazer a alegação falsa.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: A Igreja Luterana da Paz, em Joinville (SC), não foi invadida por militantes do Partido dos Trabalhadores (PT) e da Central Única dos Trabalhadores (CUT), como afirmam publicações nas redes sociais que usam imagens de um protesto de estudantes no local para fazer a alegação falsa. Estes são os principais detalhes: “Igreja da Paz em Joinville foi invadida nesta noite por militantes do PT e CUT”, dizem os posts , que circulam no Facebook, no Instagram e no Threads. Segundo o jornal O Globo, o vídeo compartilhado nas publicações foi gravado em outubro de 2022 e mostra um protesto de estudantes de uma universidade localizada no mesmo endereço da paróquia. A Igreja da Paz e a Faculdade IELUSC , ligada à instituição luterana, ficam na rua Princesa Isabel, 438 , no centro de Joinville. Na época, a Reuters publicou uma checagem desmentindo que o templo tivesse sido invadido por militantes de esquerda. A checagem informava que os estudantes protestavam contra a demissão de uma professora, supostamente devido a críticas ao então presidente e candidato à reeleição Jair Bolsonaro em uma rede social. As alegações de invasão foram desmentidas pela própria Paróquia da Paz em outubro de 2022. Procurada, a paróquia não respondeu a um pedido de comentário para esta checagem. Não há registros de protestos recentes no local. Veredicto: Falso. O vídeo mostra uma manifestação de estudantes em uma faculdade que fica no mesmo endereço de uma igreja, e não uma invasão ao templo. Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. item.title: Anthropic to add US voting information to Claude before midterms
item.description: Anthropic said on Wednesday it would add official US voting information from nonprofit Democracy Works and election results to its Claude AI chatbot later this month, ahead of the November midterms.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Anthropic said on Wednesday it would add official US voting information from nonprofit Democracy Works and election results to its Claude AI chatbot later this month, ahead of the November midterms. The AI company said its goal was to position Claude as a useful tool for political conversations, while preventing election-related abuse. "Today, conversations that touch broadly on politics, public policy or social issues account for about 5.75% of all conversations in the United States on Claude.ai, our consumer app," the company said in a statement, citing analysis of 250,000 US conversations. The move comes as AI companies increasingly position chatbots as sources of news and information, potentially helping Anthropic draw more users during the election cycle. About 0.51% of Claude conversations are specifically about elections or voting, Anthropic said, adding that it expects political and election-related queries to rise as election day approaches. Later this month, US users seeking voting logistics will receive answers drawn directly from Democracy Works’ database of state and local election sources. Anthropic said requests for recommendations on how to vote were extremely rare, accounting for just 0.01% of U.S. conversations.

item.title: NLCS resale ticket prices plummet 42% with Dodgers facing 0-2 hole
item.description: The Los Angeles Dodgers' losses in the first two games of the National League Championship Series are having an impact on resale ticket prices at Dodger Stadium.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Los Angeles Dodgers' losses in the first two games of the National League Championship Series are having an impact on resale ticket prices at Dodger Stadium. The Dodgers find themselves trailing in the best-of-seven series against the Milwaukee Brewers, with games set for Wednesday and Thursday in Los Angeles. As of early Wednesday, the get-in price (including fees) on the resale market for Game 3 had fallen in three days by 42% from $167 on Sunday night to $97 per ticket, according to TicketData. Game 4 tickets were down 37% to $98. Los Angeles led MLB in attendance for the 13th straight season with a total of 4.03 million to set a franchise record. There were 14 sellouts and 40 crowds of more than 50,000 at Dodger Stadium, the largest MLB ballpark (capacity 56,000). The average for 81 games was 49,805. While the Dodgers are trying to become the first team to win three consecutive World Series in 26 years, the Brewers are on track to reach their first World Series since 1982 -- when they were in the American League. Resale tickets for a potential World Series Game 1 in Milwaukee at American Family Field (capacity 41,900) was at $1,122 per ticket, up 2% since Monday, per TicketData. --Field Level Media

item.title: Perella Weinberg, Piper Sandler abandon merger talks, source says
item.description: Investment bank Piper Sandler and advisory firm Perella Weinberg Partners have abandoned talks for an all-stock merger as they could not agree on financial and personnel terms, a person familiar with the matter told Reuters on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Abigail Summerville
item.content:encoded: Investment bank Piper Sandler (PIPR.N) and advisory firm Perella Weinberg Partners (PWP.O) have abandoned talks for an all-stock merger as they could not agree on financial and personnel terms, a person familiar with the matter told Reuters on Wednesday. Shares of Perella Weinberg closed 19.1% lower at $13, while those of Piper Sandler ended up 0.96% at $64.5. Perella Weinberg declined to comment, while Piper Sandler did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. The Financial Times first reported on Wednesday that the merger talks fell through. The Wall Street Journal had reported last month that Piper Sandler was in talks to buy Perella Weinberg, which had a market value of about $1.4 billion at the time. A $485-million merger between Minneapolis-based Piper Jaffray and New York-based Sandler O'Neill led to the formation of Piper Sandler Companies in January 2020, creating a major investment bank specializing in the middle market, with leading advisory practices in financial services, healthcare and energy. Meanwhile, Perella Weinberg was founded by veteran Wall Street bankers Joseph Perella, Peter Weinberg and Terry Meguid in 2006. The firm went public in 2021 through a merger with a blank-check company backed by banking entrepreneur Betsy Cohen, in a deal valued at about $975 million.

item.title: Alza del IPC agudiza caída de las acciones del sector de la inteligencia artificial
item.description: Las principales acciones del sector de la inteligencia artificial se desplomaban el miércoles tras la publicación del más reciente informe sobre la inflación en Estados Unidos, lo que puso de manifiesto la preocupación de los inversionistas por los riesgos que plantea el aumento de los costos financieros en un sector que requiere un gran volumen de capital.
item.dc:creator: Chuck Mikolajczak, Darshan R, Shashwat Chauhan
item.content:encoded: Las principales acciones del sector de la inteligencia artificial se desplomaban el miércoles tras la publicación del más reciente informe sobre la inflación en Estados Unidos, lo que puso de manifiesto la preocupación de los inversionistas por los riesgos que plantea el aumento de los costos financieros en un sector que requiere un gran volumen de capital. Entre las empresas que más caían, el operador de centros de datos CoreWeave (CRWV.O) bajaba un 16%; el proveedor de infraestructura de IA Nebius (NBIS.O) retrocedía un 11%; el gigante de la computación en la nube Oracle (ORCL.N) se desplomaba un 9%; y el fabricante de servidores Dell Technologies (DELL.N) se hundía un 11%. Los descensos sumaban una pérdida de valor de mercado de 80.000 millones de dólares. Las caídas reflejan el impacto de un endurecimiento de las condiciones financieras, así como las ganancias desmesuradas obtenidas por algunos de los principales beneficiarios del auge de la IA. Barclays bajó el miércoles la recomendación para Dell y otras dos compañías de hardware empresarial, señalando que las acciones de Dell se han cuadruplicado este año por la fiebre inversora impulsada por la IA, la que ha provocado que 16 títulos del sector tecnológico del S&P 500 (.SPLRCT) se hayan, como mínimo, duplicado este año, según cálculos de Reuters. La preocupación por el aumento de los costos de financiación también lastraba a otras empresas el miércoles. El desplome era particularmente intenso en el caso de CoreWeave, que ha emitido 22.000 millones de dólares en bonos y ha tomado préstamos por 26.000 millones, según datos de LSEG. El bono de CoreWeave emitido en junio con un rendimiento del 9,625% ofrecía recientemente un retorno del 15%. "Estamos recibiendo mucha información que sugiere que las mayores empresas de IA podrían no estar generando los beneficios o los ingresos que se esperaban, y creo que eso hace que todo el mundo se sienta nervioso respecto a empresas como CoreWeave", dijo Kim Forrest, directora de inversiones de Bokeh Capital Partners. El presidente ejecutivo de CoreWeave, Mike Intrator, dijo en un memorándum interno que el mercado está actuando de forma "irracional" y que sigue confiando en la empresa de IA en la nube, informó Bloomberg el miércoles. La caída del miércoles es la más reciente señal de un mercado que lucha por asimilar las implicaciones de la alta inflación, en un momento en el que el endeudamiento corporativo impulsado por la IA ha contribuido a elevar las tasas de interés en el mundo. En general, los inversionistas siguen mostrándose optimistas respecto al sector, en parte porque sus principales actores, desde el fabricante de chips Nvidia (NVDA.O) hasta los denominados "hiperescaladores" (principalmente Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , Microsoft (MSFT.O) , Meta (META.O) y Amazon (AMZN.O) ), son muy rentables y se considera que están bien gestionados, a pesar de la preocupación por su endeudamiento. Sin embargo, el aumento de las tasas de interés encarecerá el financiamiento y la construcción, un hecho que probablemente afectará en primer lugar a las empresas no rentables y a las menos rentables. "Creo que unas tasas de largo plazo sobre el 5% y que se acercan sigilosamente al 6% suponen un problema para lo que yo llamaría los prestatarios marginales", dijo Ross Mayfield, analista de estrategia de inversión de Baird, en una entrevista con Reuters. "Se complica mucho más la situación para las empresas que se sitúan por debajo de las cuatro grandes hiperescaladoras". El índice Nasdaq (.IXIC) bajaba un 2% el miércoles por la tarde, con Alphabet y el resto de grandes hiperescaladoras con caídas de alrededor del 2%. SpaceX (SPCX.O) , otra importante empresa del sector de la IA, perdía un 3%. "Supongo que ahora el grupo ha crecido hasta cinco. SpaceX se ha sumado a la fiesta para unirse a Meta, Microsoft, Google y Amazon", dijo Jed Ellerbroek, gestor de carteras de Argent Capital Management. "Las cinco empresas están gastando alrededor del 75% del dinero que se invierte en centros de datos en el país (Estados Unidos). Y, obviamente, están destinando todas sus ganancias, e incluso algo más, a estos centros de datos, y la rentabilidad que obtienen de ellos es realmente buena".

item.title: Delantero mexicano Jiménez queda fuera de las canchas tres meses por lesión en rodilla
item.description: El delantero de la selección mexicana Raúl Jiménez estará fuera de las canchas lo que resta del año debido a una lesión en la rodilla que requiere intervención quirúrgica, informó el miércoles un directivo del club Wolverhampton Wanderers de la segunda división de Inglaterra.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El delantero de la selección mexicana Raúl Jiménez estará fuera de las canchas lo que resta del año debido a una lesión en la rodilla que requiere intervención quirúrgica, informó el miércoles un directivo del club Wolverhampton Wanderers de la segunda división de Inglaterra. El jugador de 35 años se lesionó la rodilla hace cuatro semanas durante un partido de su club ante el Everton, razón por la que no fue convocado por el director técnico de la selección mexicana Rafael Márquez para los partidos de la fecha FIFA disputados entre el 26 de septiembre y el 6 de octubre. "Raúl sufrió una lesión en el ligamento colateral medial de la rodilla izquierda contra el Everton hace cuatro semanas. Lamentablemente, la lesión no ha evolucionado como esperábamos, por lo que hemos decidido que lo mejor es operar para reparar dicho ligamento", dijo el director de rendimiento de Wolverhampton Wanderers, Phil Hayward, citado en un comunicado del club. "Se someterá a la intervención este viernes en Londres y luego afrontará unos tres meses de rehabilitación antes de estar listo para volver a jugar. Es una situación realmente decepcionante para todos, pero debemos mirar hacia adelante, realizar la operación e iniciar el proceso de rehabilitación cuanto antes para que pueda regresar al campo y ayudar al equipo lo más rápido posible", agregó. Jiménez regresó en junio al Wolverhampton Wanderers después de tres años, en los que jugó para el Fulham. En su primera etapa con los "Wolves", entre 2018 y 2023, Jiménez anotó 57 goles en 166 partidos. "Raúl está muy decepcionado, pero también contento de que ahora tengamos un plan claro y definido. Podemos trabajar sobre esa base y asegurarnos de que logre recuperarse dentro de los plazos previstos", apuntó Hayward.

item.title: Cacau em Londres atinge maior cotação em um mês; café também sobe
item.description: Os futuros de cacau em Londres atingiram a maior cotação em um mês nesta quarta-feira, impulsionados por preocupações de que o tempo seco possa reduzir a produção na África Ocidental nesta safra.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os futuros de cacau em Londres atingiram a maior cotação em um mês nesta quarta-feira, impulsionados por preocupações de que o tempo seco possa reduzir a produção na África Ocidental nesta safra. CACAU * Os futuros de cacau em Londres fecharam com alta de £25, ou 0,6%, a £4.317 por tonelada, após atingir uma máxima de um mês de £4.499. * Operadores afirmaram que o tempo seco na Costa do Marfim e em partes de Gana contribuiu para a alta dos preços, intensificando as preocupações com o impacto do fenômeno climático El Niño nas safras. * Eles observaram que os dados sobre a moagem de cacau do terceiro trimestre devem ser o foco no curto prazo. Relatórios abrangendo tanto a Europa quanto a América do Norte devem ser divulgados na quinta-feira. * A moagem de cacau da Costa do Marfim subiu 46,6% em relação ao mesmo período do ano anterior em setembro, para 49.517 toneladas de grãos, segundo dados divulgados nesta quarta-feira pela associação de exportadores GEPEX. * O cacau de Nova York ficou praticamente inalterado, a US$5.735 por tonelada. CAFÉ * O do café arábica fechou em alta de 5,35 centavos, ou 1,8%, a US$2,9805 por libra-peso, a maior cotação em uma semana. * Operadores afirmaram que o mercado foi sustentado, em parte, por preocupações de que um fenômeno El Niño reduza a produção global na safra 2027/28. * A recente valorização do real brasileiro , ligada às crescentes expectativas de que Flávio Bolsonaro seja eleito presidente após sua vitória no primeiro turno, também impulsionou os preços denominados em dólares. * Um real forte reduz o incentivo para que os cafeicultores brasileiros vendam seu café, ao diminuir os preços baseados no dólar em termos de moeda local. * O café robusta subiu 0,7%, para US$3.483 por tonelada. AÇÚCAR * O açúcar bruto fechou em queda de 0,27 centavo, ou 1,3%, a 20,84 centavos por libra-peso. * Os corretores afirmaram que o mercado perdeu o ímpeto de alta após atingir um pico de 19 meses, de 21,24 centavos, em 7 de outubro, e parecia destinado a permanecer dentro de uma faixa estreita no curto prazo. * O mercado continuou sendo sustentado pelas chuvas no Brasil, que haviam desacelerado a produção em setembro e na primeira quinzena de outubro. * O contrato de açúcar branco registrou queda de 1,2%, para US$554,90 por tonelada.

item.title: Soja recua com avanço da colheita, apesar da retomada da demanda chinesa
item.description: Os futuros de milho e soja dos Estados Unidos recuaram nesta quarta-feira, à medida que o ritmo acelerado da colheita no Meio-Oeste aumentou a oferta, com previsão de condições climáticas predominantemente favoráveis após as chuvas ocorridas no meio da semana em algumas regiões.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os futuros de milho e soja dos Estados Unidos recuaram nesta quarta-feira, à medida que o ritmo acelerado da colheita no Meio-Oeste aumentou a oferta, com previsão de condições climáticas predominantemente favoráveis após as chuvas ocorridas no meio da semana em algumas regiões. As perdas na soja foram limitadas pela notícia de que a China comprou vários carregamentos dos EUA, nas primeiras compras significativas desde uma reunião comercial de alto nível no mês passado. O trigo registrou ligeira alta devido a preocupações com a oferta da Rússia e da Ucrânia, já que ataques a navios cargueiros interromperam os embarques da região do Mar Negro. O milho e a soja continuam sustentados pela colheita em ritmo acelerado no Meio-Oeste. O Departamento de Agricultura dos EUA informou que 33% do milho e 46% da soja do país haviam sido colhidos até domingo, à medida que os agricultores aproveitaram o tempo mais seco após as chuvas terem atrasado a colheita em setembro. As chuvas desta semana paralisaram os trabalhos no campo, mas esperava-se que o tempo mais seco voltasse até o final da semana, segundo os meteorologistas. “Hoje estamos em baixa devido ao andamento do plantio e ao fato de que parece que teremos bom tempo daqui para frente. Mas estamos nos mantendo em níveis mais baixos, dentro da faixa de negociação. Os usuários finais estão intensificando as compras no mercado”, disse Jack Scoville, analista do The Price Group. Compradores do governo chinês reservaram de 8 a 10 cargas de soja dos EUA na terça-feira, informaram operadores à Reuters. O USDA confirmou a maioria das compras na quarta-feira, em um comunicado diário sobre vendas para exportação. Os operadores estão atentos a novas compras, já que a China busca cumprir um compromisso de compra anual de 25 milhões de toneladas, em meio a preocupações com o excesso de capacidade de esmagamento no país. A Administração Geral das Alfândegas da China informou uma queda de 7,7% nas importações de soja em setembro. O contrato de soja para novembro na bolsa de Chicago (CBOT) fechou com queda de 6,5 centavos, a US$12,7725 por bushel, enquanto o contrato de milho para dezembro recuou 2 centavos, para US$ 4,8075 por bushel. O trigo de dezembro da CBOT subiu 4 centavos, fechando a US$6,7325 por bushel, após a notícia de que dois navios cargueiros haviam sido atingidos por drones na costa da Bulgária.

item.title: Olympic champion Hassan withdraws from NYC Marathon
item.description: Olympic champion Sifan Hassan has dropped out of the New York City Marathon due to a setback in her training, she said on Wednesday, months after an Achilles injury forced her out of the London Marathon.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Olympic champion Sifan Hassan has dropped out of the New York City Marathon due to a setback in her training, she said on Wednesday, months after an [USN:L6N40B0UW TEXT:"Achilles injury"] forced her out of the London Marathon. Hassan, who won the Paris 2024 marathon and also picked up gold in the 5,000 and 10,000 metres at the Tokyo Games, has not competed since she last ran the five boroughs a year ago, finishing sixth. "I was so excited to come back stronger, but a sickness slowed down my training and I’m not where I wanted to be," Hassan wrote on social media. "Sometimes, things just don’t go as planned." Hassan was one of two high-profile names to drop out of the year's final marathon major on Wednesday. US Olympic trials champion Fiona O'Keeffe also withdrew due to injury.

item.title: Petróleo sobe com ataques na Arábia Saudita e novas táticas do Irã para atacar petroleiros
item.description: Os preços do petróleo subiram nesta quarta-feira, depois que os houthis atacaram a sede da Saudi Aramco e o Irã afirmou que estava adotando novas táticas para atacar navios e manter os preços do petróleo elevados.
item.dc:creator: Nicole Jao
item.content:encoded: Os preços do petróleo subiram nesta quarta-feira, depois que os houthis atacaram a sede da Saudi Aramco e o Irã afirmou que estava adotando novas táticas para atacar navios e manter os preços do petróleo elevados. Os contratos futuros do petróleo Brent fecharam com alta de 0,35%, a US$106,06 o barril. O petróleo West Texas Intermediate (WTI) dos Estados Unidos subiu 1,01%, para US$95,09, a maior cotação em três semanas. Os ataques a navios que transitam pelo Estreito de Ormuz e os confrontos entre a Arábia Saudita e os houthis, aliados do Irã, estão elevando os preços do petróleo, disse Phil Flynn, analista sênior do Price Futures Group. “Estamos vendo muitas negociações motivadas pelo medo hoje”, acrescentou Flynn. Autoridades iranianas se recusaram a fornecer detalhes sobre a nova estratégia para atacar navios, mas uma delas afirmou que o Irã começou a usar táticas ofensivas diferentes há cerca de 10 dias. Os fluxos de petróleo do Golfo Pérsico, excluindo o Irã, dispararam em setembro para mais de 81% dos níveis pré-guerra, segundo dados, impulsionados por uma recuperação nas exportações sauditas. As exportações iranianas caíram para zero devido a um bloqueio dos Estados Unidos. “Mais petróleo chegando aos mercados internacionais não significa necessariamente que mais petróleo esteja sendo produzido”, afirmou o analista Ole Hansen, do Saxo Bank, em uma nota. “Parte da recuperação reflete uma redistribuição dos barris disponíveis, incluindo volumes que, de outra forma, teriam abastecido as refinarias regionais.” ATAQUES EM VÁRIAS FRENTES Os houthis atacaram um prédio administrativo pertencente à empresa estatal de petróleo Saudi Aramco (2222.SE) na cidade de Dhahran, causando um incêndio de pequena magnitude, informou o Ministério da Energia da Arábia Saudita. O grupo lançou mísseis balísticos e drones contra a Arábia Saudita na última semana, no que afirma ser uma retaliação ao apoio do reino às forças governamentais iemenitas. O aeroporto internacional de Riade foi atingido quatro vezes, com um ataque no sábado que matou 13 pessoas. Enquanto isso, um navio porta-contêineres afundou em águas ao sul do Estreito de Ormuz após colidir com uma mina naval e pegar fogo, informou a Marinha da Guarda Revolucionária do Irã em comunicado divulgado pela mídia estatal nesta quarta-feira. Isso ocorreu um dia depois que a Agência de Operações de Comércio Marítimo do Reino Unido informou que um navio porta-contêineres e um petroleiro foram atingidos por projéteis desconhecidos dentro do estreito. “A expectativa de que o aumento das exportações russas de diesel alivie a escassez no mercado provavelmente limitará movimentos bruscos de preço em qualquer direção”, disse Hiroyuki Kikukawa, estrategista-chefe da Nissan Securities Investment.

item.title: Mexico's Banamex markets risky debt ahead of Citi split
item.description: Mexican lender Banamex is marketing its first sale of high-risk bonds, a key move to reshape its capital structure as it prepares for independence from its parent, US banking giant Citigroup .
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Mexican lender Banamex is marketing its first sale of high-risk bonds, a key move to reshape its capital structure as it prepares for independence from its parent, US banking giant Citigroup (C.N) . The offering of [USN:Ifp4Y5MPH TEXT:"US-dollar perpetual bonds"] - reported on Wednesday by financial publication IFR - is the latest step in Banamex's strategy to build a standalone balance sheet and broaden its international investor base. The deal follows a $1.3 billion debt sale in May, its first in decades. Citigroup has been unwinding its ownership of the Mexican bank, recently selling a 49% stake to a [USN:S0N3UB042 TEXT:"group of investors"] that includes Mexican businessman [USN:L3N3VB1D0 TEXT:"Fernando Chico Pardo"], Blackstone, and General Atlantic. Citigroup retains a 51% stake, which it is expected to sell through an [USN:L4N3ZJ1O3 TEXT:"initial public offering"] (IPO) in 2027. The "Additional Tier 1" (AT1) notes are designed to absorb losses. Investors could see their holdings written off if the bank's capital drops below a specific level. The notes are expected to receive a non-investment grade, or "junk," rating, according to the IFR report and an investor-meeting invitation seen by Reuters. Citigroup is serving as the global coordinator and active bookrunner for the deal, according to the invitation.

item.title: Eagles open practice windows for LG Landon Dickerson, 3 others
item.description: The Philadelphia Eagles opened the 21-day practice windows on Wednesday for three-time Pro Bowl guard Landon Dickerson and three other players.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Philadelphia Eagles opened the 21-day practice windows on Wednesday for three-time Pro Bowl guard Landon Dickerson and three other players. Dickerson struggled through a knee injury in the Eagles' 24-22 victory over the Washington Commanders on Sept. 13 and was placed on injured reserve the following day. Also on Wednesday, running back Saquon Barkley wasn't spotted during the portion of practice open to the media, while wide receiver DeVonta Smith was working on the JUGS machine. Both players are working their way back from hamstring injuries. As for Dickerson, his injury is separate from the knee problem that hindered him last season. Dickerson underwent surgery in August 2025 to repair a meniscus injury, then returned to start 15 games, later acknowledging he came back before he was fully recovered. Dickerson, 28, has started all but one of the 79 games in which he has appeared since being selected by the Eagles in the second round of the 2021 NFL Draft. The Eagles also opened the 21-day practice windows for defensive back Jakorian Bennett and tight ends Grant Calcaterra and Eli Stowers on Wednesday. --Field Level Media

item.title: Goolsbee de la Fed afirma que datos del IPC de septiembre fueron desalentadores: Yahoo Finance
item.description: El presidente del Banco de la Reserva Federal de Chicago, Austan Goolsbee, afirmó el miércoles que los últimos datos sobre la inflación al consumo le tenían preocupado.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El presidente del Banco de la Reserva Federal de Chicago, Austan Goolsbee, afirmó el miércoles que los últimos datos sobre la inflación al consumo le tenían preocupado. Los datos del índice de precios al consumo de septiembre, que mostraron presiones sobre los precios superiores a lo esperado, eran "desalentadores", afirmó Goolsbee en una entrevista con Yahoo Finance. En lo que respecta a los datos sobre la presión de los precios, "me preocupa, no solo la cifra global, sino que, si se desglosan los componentes, la inflación de los servicios muestra pocos signos de mejora", señaló el responsable, al tiempo que afirmó que el banco central volverá a situar la inflación en su objetivo del 2 %.

item.title: Ocho estados de EEUU demandan a OpenAI, alegando que ChatGPT perjudica a los niños
item.description: Iowa, Kansas y otros seis estados anunciaron el miércoles que habían demandado a OpenAI en tribunales por los daños que, dicen, ChatGPT ha causado a los niños, alegando que el chatbot ha incitado a los niños a hacerse daño a sí mismos o a otros.
item.dc:creator: Diana Jones
item.content:encoded: Iowa, Kansas y otros seis estados anunciaron el miércoles que habían demandado a OpenAI en tribunales por los daños que, dicen, ChatGPT ha causado a los niños, alegando que el chatbot ha incitado a los niños a hacerse daño a sí mismos o a otros. Las demandas, presentadas ante tribunales estatales, solicitan una orden que obligue a OpenAI a modificar el funcionamiento de ChatGPT en lo que respecta a los menores. Los estados también solicitan una orden que obligue a la empresa a renunciar a los beneficios que ha obtenido gracias a los usuarios jóvenes. El fiscal general de Florida fue el primero en demandar a OpenAI, presentando en junio una demanda por motivos similares. La empresa también se enfrenta a decenas de demandas en las que se alega que ChatGPT ha contribuido a tiroteos masivos y otros actos violentos.

item.title: Fed's Goolsbee says September CPI data was discouraging - Yahoo Finance
item.description: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago President Austan Goolsbee said on Wednesday the latest consumer-level inflation data left him worried about the state of price pressures.
item.dc:creator: Michael Derby
item.content:encoded: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago President Austan Goolsbee said on Wednesday the latest consumer-level inflation data left him worried about the state of price pressures. The September [USN:L1N45Z121 TEXT:"consumer price index"] data, which showed higher-than-expected price pressures, was “discouraging,” Goolsbee said in an interview with Yahoo Finance. When it comes to the price pressure data, “I'm concerned, related to not just the overall number, but if you break out the components, services inflation shows little sign of improvement,” the official said, while affirming the central bank will get inflation back to its 2% target. Goolsbee stopped short of saying how he thinks the central bank should respond with rate policy in the near term while saying in strong terms that the Fed can't allow high price pressures to persist. If inflation pressures remain elevated, "there's not ambiguity about what, how the central bank has to deal with that," he said. "You must prevent the buildup of overheating, because if you get overheating buildup on the demand side, that tends to be very persistent and hard to get rid of," Goolsbee said. The Fed raised its interest rate target by a quarter percentage point last month to between 3.75% and 4% and penciled in an additional increase by the end of the year, as it works to get inflation to its 2% target. Key Fed officials have [USN:S0N44V01O TEXT:"waved"] markets off expectations of a rate hike at the Federal Open Market Committee meeting set for the end of the month, though the release of the CPI data put new life into market expectations that the central bank may move again sooner rather than later. In the interview, Goolsbee explained that the inflation data showed that price pressures are high even in the areas outside those directly impacted by things like tariffs, which is in part why he found the latest report to be so vexing. "This month's reading is over 5% for services inflation and you can't really attribute services inflation to tariffs, to oil prices, or things like that," Goolsbee said. "On the ground here in the Midwest, everywhere we're going, we're hearing about costs and we're hearing about prices," Goolsbee said. "There's very little that we're hearing that sounds like downturn, risks of recession and things like that, so that makes you more nervous about demand side overheating than just straight supply shock." The Fed has failed to get inflation back to its 2% target for over five years, though officials say market and public expectations data shows continued confidence that price pressures will be brought under control.

item.title: What is Starshield, SpaceX's military version of Starlink?
item.description: Ukraine said on Wednesday that Elon Musk's SpaceX had restricted military-grade Starlink services, hampering Ukrainian drone strike missions and air defenses.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ukraine said on Wednesday that Elon Musk's [USN:L8N4600M6 TEXT:"SpaceX had restricted "military-grade" Starlink services"], hampering Ukrainian drone strike missions and air defenses. The complaint has drawn renewed attention to the distinction between Starlink, SpaceX's commercial satellite internet service, and Starshield, a military version developed for the Pentagon. While Musk has said the two systems are separate, in many cases they share the same underlying satellite technology. "Starshield systems are owned and controlled by the US government," Musk said on Wednesday in a post on X, adding that any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military or the president. "Starlink is a commercial service owned and controlled by SpaceX. Usage of Starlink is limited to civilian or defensive activities and cannot be used for offensive military action, as doing so would be inappropriate for a commercial company." WHAT IS STARLINK? Starlink, the main profit engine of SpaceX (SPCX.O) , is a satellite internet network of more than 11,000 satellites that beam broadband service directly to user terminals about the size of a folded newspaper. Its roughly 13 million subscribers range from households and hikers to shipping companies and major airlines. Since launching its first Starlink satellites in 2019 aboard reusable SpaceX rockets, the company has built a vast low-Earth-orbit constellation that blankets much of the planet, delivering faster connections than traditional communications satellites, which typically operate much farther from Earth and in far smaller numbers. Starlink gave Ukraine a critical communications advantage early in the war, reshaping how militaries operate on the battlefield. But Musk has restricted Starlink for certain military uses while highlighting Starshield, a more secure network developed for government and military missions. WHAT IS STARSHIELD? Starshield is a SpaceX business unit that develops military and intelligence satellite systems for the Pentagon. While its missions are separate from Starlink's commercial broadband service, the distinction is not always clear-cut: Starshield's secure communications services use enhanced encryption and dedicated terminals, but rely on the vast Starlink constellation as their backbone. Starshield leverages the technology, engineering and operational experiences of Starlink, according to SpaceX. In addition to secure communications, the company says the militarized version can also provide users with Earth observation and the ability to integrate sensors or other payloads. The Pentagon, Starshield's largest customer, has spent billions of dollars on both Starlink and Starshield services. It has also bought dedicated Starshield satellites, including communications spacecraft for missile-warning missions and a spy constellation for the National Reconnaissance Office, Reuters reported in 2024. Questions over the relationship between Starlink and Starshield have persisted since [USN:L1N31S38K TEXT:"Russia threatened Western satellites supporting Ukraine in 2022"]. SpaceX unveiled Starshield later that year, but the secrecy surrounding national security space programs has left the precise boundaries between the two systems opaque. Those distinctions became a point of contention earlier this year when the [USN:L6N41W1B2 TEXT:"Pentagon clashed with SpaceX over higher prices for satellite services"] used by military drones during the Iran conflict, Reuters reported. SpaceX argued that some customers paying roughly $5,000 per terminal for Starlink should instead have been using a Starshield service costing about $25,000 per terminal. [USN:L6N4290XG TEXT:"Britain has also adopted Starshield"]. Under that arrangement, the service uses the same satellite constellation, ground stations and terrestrial infrastructure as Starlink, but operates through dedicated terminals and separate network gateways, Britain’s defence ministry has told Reuters. Other US partners are evaluating the system as well. New Zealand is doing a trial of Starshield to assess its usefulness for military operations, the New Zealand Defence Force previously told Reuters.

item.title: Former portfolio manager sues Fidelity after leaving for Michael Dell's family office
item.description: A former semiconductor fund manager at Fidelity Investment Management has sued its parent company FMR, claiming it refused to pay him a "multimillion-dollar" compensation package after he joined DFO Management, the family office of billionaire Dell Technologies founder Michael Dell.
item.dc:creator: Suzanne McGee
item.content:encoded: A former semiconductor fund manager at Fidelity Investment Management has sued its parent company FMR, claiming it refused to pay him a "multimillion-dollar" compensation package after he joined DFO Management, the family office of billionaire Dell Technologies (DELL.N) founder Michael Dell. The suit, filed by Adam Benjamin in the Suffolk Division of the Superior Court of Massachusetts, alleges that after Fidelity executives failed to persuade him to stay at the firm, the company "turned on a dime" and terminated him on July 10 of this year. Fidelity then imposed a non-compete clause, causing him to forfeit a compensation package totaling in the millions of dollars. "Rather than protecting any legitimate business interests, the provisions are being broadly misused by Fidelity as a retention tool or improper barrier/deterrent to" Benjamin's ability to pursue other professional opportunities, the lawsuit alleges. Fidelity declined to comment on the lawsuit, which was filed on Friday. Neither Benjamin nor his lawyers could be reached for comment. Non-compete agreements are common in the asset management industry. Benjamin managed the $48 billion Fidelity Select Semiconductors Portfolio, which is up 58% so far this year, compared to 13.3% for the S&P 500 (.SPX) index. Its average annual return of 37.4% over the last five years puts it in the top percentile of all comparable funds rated by Morningstar, which awarded the fund five stars and a gold medalist rating, its top score. Benjamin began working at DFO on October 1, the lawsuit said. He alleged that Fidelity's withholding of compensation rests on the false claim that he was joining a competitor. He said he has never worked for Fidelity's own family office business.

item.title: US judge won't block Trump order targeting DEI by federal contractors
item.description: A federal judge declined on Wednesday to block an effort by President Donald Trump to eliminate diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives by companies that do business with the US government.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Wiessner
item.content:encoded: A federal judge declined on Wednesday to block an effort by President Donald Trump to eliminate diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives by companies that do business with the US government.
